purpose: Teach: 連敗/概観/旧来/番地/大口/取り決め/売り手/融通

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、地域の安全に連敗は許されない
lines.en: The police cannot afford to fail when it comes to community safety.
lines.style: Measured, formal opening. Steady conviction without rigidity. Slight weight on the phrase itself — this is a statement of principle. Clear-eyed, professional tone. No rushing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、犯罪状況の概観を発表されてますね
lines.en: Yes. I see the police have been releasing regular crime reports.
lines.style: Attentive, affirming nod in the voice. Slightly deferential but not obsequious — acknowledging what he's heard. Warm enough to show genuine interest. Measured pace, no hurry.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、旧来の防犯手法と新手法を組み合わせます
lines.en: We're combining traditional crime-prevention methods with newer approaches.
lines.style: Precise, methodical delivery. Slight pause before the compound action — showing care in how he's explaining this. Professional but not distant. Direct eye contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、通報番地を確実に特定なさるんですね
lines.en: Yes. The police are making sure to pinpoint the exact location of each call, then.
lines.style: Appreciative affirmation. A touch of recognition — he's understood something important being said. Warm but still formal. Slight uplift at the end, showing he's tracked the logic.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、大口振り込め詐欺の事件を捜査しております
lines.en: We're currently investigating a major fraud case involving large wire transfers.
lines.style: Factual, authoritative but not cold. Slight gravitas on the fraud detail — this matters. Steady pacing. Professional distance maintained without becoming distant.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、関係機関と取り決めを結ばれたんですね
lines.en: Yes. So the police have established agreements with related agencies.
lines.style: Clear understanding reflected back. A note of respect — he sees the coordination involved. Slightly warmer than before, showing genuine appreciation for the work. Still formal but no longer stiff.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、悪質な売り手による詐欺を取り締まります
lines.en: We're cracking down on fraud perpetrated by unscrupulous merchants.
lines.style: Firm, decisive tone on the action verb. Conviction without aggression. Clean articulation — this is about protection, not punishment. Professional authority comfortable in itself.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、市民への融通の利く対応、ありがたいです
lines.en: Yes. I'm grateful for how flexibly and responsively the police have worked with citizens.
lines.style: Genuine warmth breaking through the formality. Sincere appreciation — not performative. Softer attack than before, more personal. A moment of real human acknowledgment before returning to duty.
